newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves to banking system Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves to banking system Thurs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to add reserves to the banking system during its usual midmorning intervention period Thursday, perhaps via 14-day fixed-term repurchase agreements, economists said.

On Wednesday the Fed entered the system twice, the first time it had done so since announcing late last year it would exercise its option to do so any time it felt such operations were warranted. It has done so in the past, however, and Wednesday's dual interventions carried no policy significance.
Fed funds were trading at 5-1/2 percent, right at the Fed's current official target range.
